verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Conductor helping a developer review a workspace's diff before opening a PR, and running agents on a schedule or via GitHub action. Neither is a documented automatic code-review feature that posts contextual feedback on every pull request. Routines are a building block a user could configure, not the capability itself, and loading PR comments is about reading existing feedback rather than generating it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
